BANGLADESH"; further Bangladesh buyers listed: DEKKO ACCESSORIES LTD (93), BAROTOPA PRINTERS LIMITED (27), YOUNGSHINE PACKTRIMS LIMITED (21). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 4869 Records detected", "Trading Partners 13", "Ports 23"; rows actually visible on the free page: 4 import rows (dated 2026-02-27, BOL 7780665, HS 84831099 / 73182990 / 73209090, origin Tokyo Narita JP, destination Delhi Air Cargo ACC) plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows — i.e. 4 dated shipment rows seen out of 4869 claimed. NOTE: the dated rows with HS codes and BOL numbers are INBOUND (Japan -> India, Komori Corporation -> Komori India); the outbound Bangladesh/Ethiopia counterparties are shown only as aggregated buyer totals without date, HS code or B/L number, so export direction is evidenced by counterparty aggregation, not by a dated B/L line.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. Only indirect domestic signal: the same ImportKey supplier block lists Indian consignees alongside Komori India — "KOMORI INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, SECURITY PRINTING AND MINTING CORPORATION OF INDIA, BHARATIYA RESERVE BANK NOTE MUDRAN PRIVATE LIMITED, NATIONAL BANKNOTE PRINTING PLANT" — which indicates supply into Indian state security-printing entities, but no contract, tender reference, value or date is shown.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in Indian customs data; no liquidation/bankruptcy indicator found, so no rejection ground. Declared HS 848180 (valves) does NOT match observed trade: the dated customs rows are offset-press parts under HS 84831099, 73182990, 73209090, and the company is the Indian arm of Komori Corporation (Japan) — printing machinery, not oil/gas/chemical valves. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the printing-machinery/parts group (8483/8443 family) and verdict recorded as accepted_hs_corrected. Role: this is a subsidiary/importer-distributor of a foreign manufacturer (manufacturer_trader), not a trader-only shell. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reachable here; do not estimate. Evidence quality caveat: only one source (ImportKey) was reachable; its free view exposes 4 dated rows against a claimed 4869, and the export side is counterparty aggregation only. Domestic supply is therefore 'declared_only' — the SPCM/Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran consignee listing is a customs-side indication, not a verified GST turnover or tender award.
